ideas.name: Positive Funding Spot-Perpetual Hedge
ideas.claim: Buy spot and short an equivalent perpetual position to collect positive funding payments.
ideas.quote: 对于 VIP0 交易者来说，如果每 8 小时间隔的的资金费率为 0.01%，并假设没有价差盈亏 (0 USDT)，则大约需要 10 天抵消手续费并实现盈利。
ideas.mechanism: Funding payments on a hedged spot and perpetual futures position

rules.timeframe: Funding every 8 hours in the example; holding period approximately 10 days to offset fees under its assumptions
rules.entry: Buy spot and sell an equivalent perpetual position when funding is positive
rules.filters: Positive funding; entry spread limit -0.1% and exit spread limit 0.1% for the bot

ideas.claimed_result: Hypothetical example: approximately 10 days to offset fees at 0.01% funding every 8 hours, assuming no spread profit or loss.
